title: New Budget is bounced back to the first budget instead of opening the created one
notes: Pre-existing (same shell + MenuPanes code as syscd). NewBudgetPane dispatches switchBudget(created.id) before the Budgets list refetches; BudgetLayout's reconcile effect sees the id missing from the stale list and switches to budgets.data[0]. FreshStartPane awaits refetchBudgets first; NewBudgetPane does not. Traced via localStorage writes: new id, then aaaa...0002.
